title: Laws About Vows

questions.question: What is the valuation of a male from twenty to sixty years old?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:3 (ESV): "The valuation of liquidating a vow... shall be fifty shekels of silver."

questions.question: Who sets the valuation if someone is too poor to pay?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:8 (ESV): "Then he shall be presented before the priest, and the priest shall value him."

questions.question: If someone wants to redeem his house after dedicating it, how much must he add?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:15 (ESV): "He shall add a fifth of the valuation in money to it, and it shall be his."

questions.question: To whom does every tithe of the land belong?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:30 (ESV): "Every tithe of the land... is the Lord's; it is holy to the Lord."

questions.question: What happens if a man wishes to redeem some of his tithe?
options: He shall add a fifth to it
questions.correctAnswer: He shall add a fifth to it
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:31 (ESV): "If a man wishes to redeem some of his tithe, he shall add a fifth to it."

questions.question: What is the valuation for a female from twenty to sixty years old?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:4 (ESV): "If the person is a female, the valuation shall be thirty shekels."

questions.question: Can a firstborn animal be dedicated as a vow?
options: No, it is already the Lord's
Only if it is a bull
Only if it is a sheep
questions.correctAnswer: No, it is already the Lord's
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:26 (ESV): "But a firstborn of animals... no man may dedicate; whether ox or sheep, it is the Lord's."

questions.question: What is a "devoted thing"?
options: Anything devoted to the Lord (herem) which cannot be sold or redeemed
questions.correctAnswer: Anything devoted to the Lord (herem) which cannot be sold or redeemed
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:28 (ESV): "But no devoted thing that a man devotes to the Lord... may be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy to the Lord."

questions.question: How is the tithe of the herd or flock determined?
options: Whatever passes under the shepherd's staff, the tenth one
questions.correctAnswer: Whatever passes under the shepherd's staff, the tenth one
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:32 (ESV): "And every tithe of herds and flocks, every tenth animal of all that pass under the herdsman's staff, shall be holy to the Lord."

questions.question: Should a person look for the good or bad when selecting the tithe animal?
options: No, he shall not distinguish between good or bad
questions.correctAnswer: No, he shall not distinguish between good or bad
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:33 (ESV): "He shall not distinguish between good or bad, neither shall he make an exchange for it."

questions.question: What is the valuation for a child from a month to five years old (male)?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:6 (ESV): "The valuation... for the male... shall be five shekels of silver."

questions.question: If a field is dedicated during the Year of Jubilee, at what value does it stand?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:17 (ESV): "If he dedicates his field from the year of jubilee, the valuation shall stand."

questions.question: If the field is dedicated after the Jubilee, how is it valued?
options: According to the years that remain until the next Jubilee
questions.correctAnswer: According to the years that remain until the next Jubilee
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:18 (ESV): "The priest shall calculate the money... according to the years that remain until the year of jubilee, and a deduction shall be made."

questions.question: What happens if a devoted person (herem) is ransomed?
options: He shall surely be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: He shall surely be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:29 (ESV): "No one devoted, who is to be devoted for destruction from mankind, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death."

questions.question: Where were these commandments given?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 27:34 (ESV): "These are the commandments that the Lord commanded Moses for the people of Israel on Mount Sinai."

key_verse_text: Every tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the Lord's; it is holy to the Lord.
